messages.content: Fulton Market and River North are excellent choices for their upscale atmosphere, vibrant community vibe, and high pedestrian safety. While specific "no-go" zones change frequently due to recent community events, general advice is to stay well-lit, avoid isolated dark alleys late at night, and rely on ride-shares or tram services rather than walking alone in less monitored city blocks. Pre-booking your accommodations and wearing headphones while walking are also practical steps to feel more secure; familiarizing yourself with these neighborhoods before you arrive will significantly reduce your anxiety about navigating Chicago solo.
